Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 21626 of 2025
Applicant :- Iqbal Ahmad

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Vishwakarma,Ramesh Kumar Ojha
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ramesh Kumar Ojha, learned counsel for applicant and learned Aga for the
State-respondents.

2.  The present application has been preferred for seeking quashing of chargesheet no.652A/2015 dated 31.03.2016 and summoning order dated 27.04.2016 along with further proceedings of Session Trial No.218 of 2016, arising out of Case Crime No.914 of 2015, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC and Section 15 of D.A.A. Act, P.S. Sikandra, District Agra, pending in the court of learned Additional District Judge, Court No.11, Agra.
3.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Court No.11, Agra
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Brief facts of the present case are that initially applicant along with certain other co-accused persons was implicated in Case Crime No.914 of 2015 in pursuance of Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 Iqbal Ahmad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169949322/
1 IPC and Section 15 of D.A.A. Act, P.S. Sikandra, District Agra, wherein chargesheet no.652/2015 was submitted on dated 23.11.2015 against all accused persons except one Pradeep Bhadauriya against whom inquiry was still pending.

entities.text: Iqbal Ahmad vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: All the accused including applicant was summoned and are facing trial of S.S.T. No.445 of 2015.

Later on, chargesheet no.652A/2015 was submitted on dated 31.03.2016 by way of implicating Pradeep Bhadauriya and all other five co-accused wherein applicant was one of them but at the time of taking cognizance of offence, learned court concerned issued summoning order dated 27.04.2016 against Pradeep Bhadauriya since rest of other accused have already put their appearance and facing trial by way of attending proceedings continuously before learned trial court in S.S.T. No.445 of 2015.

Trial of co-accused i.e. Pradeep Bhadauriya was also started in shape of S.S.T No.218 of 2016.
4.

It is apparent from the ordersheet of both the trials numbered as mentioned above that applicant is continuously appearing in S.S.T. No.445 of 2015 and in the year 2022, learned District Judge,
Agra transferred S.S.T. No.218 of 2016 pertains to Pradeep Bhadauriya before learned court of Additional District Judge, Court No.13, Agra and under some intermingling of both the cases i.e.
S.S.T. No.445 of 2015 and S.S.T No.218 of 2016, even after appearance of applicant in S.S.T. No.445 of 2015, non bailable warrant has been issued against applicant in S.S.T No.218 of 2016 in which applicant has never been summoned by learned court concerned at the time of taking cognizance of offence.

5. Ordersheet of S.S.T. No.218 of 2016 has not been appended by learned counsel for applicant to the present application and the same has handed over today which is taken on record and the same shall be part of the present application.

6. Learned counsel for applicant submitted that applicant had never been summoned at the time of taking cognizance of in the case which was registered as S.S.T. No.218 of 2016 and he is continuously appearing in S.S.T. No.445 of 2015 and as such, order of issuing non bailable warrant in S.S.T. No.218 of 2016, is illegal.
7.

Learned AGA has also agreed that applicant is continuously appearing before learned trial court concerned in S.S.T. No.445 of 2015 and once he has not been summoned at the time of taking cognizance of offence by learned court concerned in respect of S.S.T. No.218 of 2016, there is hardly any occasion before learned court concerned for issuing non bailable warrant against applicant.
8.

After having contentions of learned counsel for parties and perusal of records, it is apparent that for same case crime number, two separate trials are being conducted before two learned Sessions Courts and applicant is in accused in S.S.T. No.445 of 2015 and he had never been summoned at the time of taking cognizance of in the case which was registered as S.S.T. No.218 of 2016 and as such,
order of issuing non bailable warrant against applicant inS.S.T. No.218 of 2016, is illegal which might be issued under some confusion.
9.
In view thereof, order of issuing non bailable warrant against applicant, is hereby quashed.
10. Accordingly, the instant application is allowed.

sentences.text:
However, to avoid any complexity and to provide proper opportunity of initiating prosecution as well as taking defence in Case Crime No.914 of 2015, learned District Judge, Agra is hereby directed to club S.S.T. No.445 of 2015 and S.S.T. No.218 of 2016 with each other since both the trials have been arisen out of same case crime number wherein at the time of initiation of matter in shape of lodging FIR against all the six accused who were properly named in the FIR but chargesheet was preferred in two sets; in first set, five accused including the applicant was submitted being chargesheet no.652/2015 and in second set, chargesheet no.652A/2015 was submitted against Pradeep Bhadauriya along with five other co-accused again but at the time ot taking cognizance of offence, learned court concerned took cognizance of offence only against Pradeep Bhadauriya.
12.
It is also made clear that the protection and relief as granted above, is strictly applicable to the applicant herein only.
